metadata.title: Ecosystem Expansion: The Connective Mycelium
metadata.notes: Closing the remaining gaps in civilizational breadth and depth.

nodes.title: Value Topology
nodes.description: Graph theory applied to economics. Mapping how TEND and resources flow through a mesh. Identifying extractive bottlenecks and creating regenerative 'Eddies' in the local economy.

nodes.title: Mutual Credit & Demurrage
nodes.description: The math of non-extractive credit. How to design a currency that encourages circulation rather than hoarding. Calculating trust-weighted credit limits.

nodes.title: The Architecture of Agency
nodes.description: Formal proof of agent-centricity. Why keeping data on the source chain is a technical requirement for human sovereignty. Comparison with centralized data-silos.

nodes.title: P2P Network Topology
nodes.description: The physics of the mesh. Gossip protocols, DHT sharding, and the mathematics of local discovery via LoRa and Wi-Fi. Optimizing for resilient, off-grid routing.

nodes.title: Physical Logic: Pulleys & Levers
nodes.description: The first computers. Mechanical advantage as a form of physical logic. Understanding ratios, torque, and leverage as prerequisites for engineering.

nodes.title: Biological Feedback & Homeostasis
nodes.description: Nature's Active Inference. How plants regulate water and bodies regulate heat. The foundation for understanding complex feedback loops in cities.

nodes.title: Logical Connectives in the World
nodes.description: AND, OR, NOT and XOR. Visualizing Boolean logic through physical switches, water valves, and circuit gates. The grammar of all following technical tracks.

nodes.title: Conceptual Blending & Metaphor
nodes.description: How the mind builds new meaning. Blending HDC-bound semantic concepts into resonant cultural metaphors. The linguistics of collective intelligence.

nodes.title: Sovereign Protocol Capstone
nodes.description: Design and formally verify a new Mycelix protocol extension (zome or bridge) that addresses a specific community need while maintaining the 16 obligations.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A functioning, auditable Holochain zome with a verified EML proof of alignment.

edges.rationale: Hyperdimensional logic is built upon the foundation of Boolean connectives.
Mechanical advantage is the first step toward understanding bipedal torque and balance.
Thermodynamic governance requires a deep understanding of value topology.
One cannot design a sovereign protocol without mastering the architecture of agency.
